sentences.japanese: イエス、ナタナエルの己が許に來たるを見、これを指して言ひ給ふ「視よ、眞にイスラエル人なり、その衷に噓僞なし」。
sentences.english: When Jesus saw Nathanael approaching, he said of him, "Here truly is an Israelite in whom there is no deceit."

sentences.japanese: 他人を支配せんと思う者は先ず己を支配せよ。
sentences.english: He that would govern others, first should be master of himself.

sentences.japanese: 他人を己を持って計ってはいけない。
sentences.english: You must not judge others by yourself.

sentences.japanese: 人間は己の肉体なり心の病気の餌食であり、死んだ後では地虫の餌食となる。
sentences.english: Man, being of flesh, is subject to diseases of the mind and after death, to worms.

sentences.japanese: 若者は己の貪欲の犠牲になりがちである。
sentences.english: Young men are apt to fall a victim to their own avarice.
